title: Iowa family moves a $12,000 farmhouse four miles on wheels for dream home
summary_full: An adventurous Iowa family took on the challenge of rescuing an abandoned farmhouse they believed held untold stories. By moving the century-old building four miles to their land, they endeavored to preserve history while crafting their dream home. Faced with surprising renovations and repair costs, they shared their transformative journey online, earning a global audience and ultimately building a unique family haven that mingled modern life with historical charm.
